description.zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。
description.en: The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

description.zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

>相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填。
description.en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

> This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port.
The ID of the CLB instance.

description.zh:
负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
访问控制列表。

监听的**AccessControlStatus**为**open_white_list**时有效。

支持输入IP地址或IP地址段（CIDR block形式），多个IP地址或地址段用半角逗号（,）分割。

不允许输入**0.0.0.0**或**0.0.0.0/0**。您可以通过调用[SetListenerAccessControlStatus](~~27599~~)接口将**AccessControlStatus**的值设置为**close**来关闭访问控制。
description.en:
The IP addresses or CIDR blocks that you want to add to the whitelist.

This parameter takes effect when the **AccessControlStatus** parameter of the listener is set to **open\_white\_list**.

Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,).

You cannot enter **0.0.0.0** or **0.0.0.0/0**. To disable access control, you can call the [SetListenerAccessControlStatus](~~27599~~) operation to set the value of the **AccessControlStatus** parameter to **close**.

title.zh: 添加监听访问控制白名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb add-listener-white-list-item --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1o94dp5i6ea0000000 --listener-port 80 --source-items 192.168.XX.XX --listener-protocol https --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
